items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 03 May 2026 at 8:10am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure covers the mid-Atlantic, with a slack area of low pressure centred over England, bringing various weak fronts across the British Isles.


##Wind##

Mainly North or Northeast 2 to 4, increasing occasionally 5 in the west of the area tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Mainly slight, but smooth in places.


##Weather##

Patchy rain, becoming mainly fair this afternoon.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Mainly North or Northeast 2 to 4, occasionally 5 in the west at first, becoming Variable 2 to 4 in all waters tomorrow morning, settling mainly Northerly tomorrow afternoon, then North or Northwest later.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
